jobs.description: Silver refresh of the 대수선 lane `building-permit-major-repair` (root ADR-0169 ②, ADR-0402): pick the newest complete hub.go.kr release in the Bronze ledger and, unless silver.building_permit_major_repair already records it or a newer one (`unchanged`), export it, stage it on a load branch, compare it with the table's current rows in one bucket and append to main only the rows it has not held and a removal marker per row it no longer holds (each row keyed by its SHA-256) (lane contract compare.content_columns; root ADR-0318), and read it back (`changed`). Started when a source_sweep run lands new files, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). One lane runs at a time: each takes the compose `spark` cap.

first_run.estimated_from: computed, about 2.5x the nearest larger measured neighbours on the same template unit (root ADR-0386): silver_refresh_building_permit_basis_outline 357 s for a 438 MB release, _parking 251 s for 59 MB, _demolition_loss 161 s for 15 MB; this lane's newest release is about 3 MB in the Bronze ledger (2026-11-09)

assets.title: 건축인허가 대수선
assets.description: 대수선 항목마다 한 행: 대수선구분(내력벽·기둥·보·방화구획 등)·변경구분(증설·해체·수선·변경)과 허가 키(관리허가대장PK). 건물 수명 사건열의 중간이다. 한 허가에 여러 행이라 행 글자의 SHA-256 이 키다. 원문 16칸 보존. 필지 by-PNU 종류 parcel-building-permits 가 행의 PNU 로 필지 문서의 목록 하나로 싣는다(루트 ADR-0402, ADR-0464).

dependencies.description: 대수선(mart_kcy_05) 16칸을 행마다 새 행·사라진 행만 append-only Silver 로 쌓는다(루트 ADR-0402).
dependencies.pnu_resolution: pnu composed at Silver by the Rust hub/VWorld export (export-*-silver-handoff, standard_pnu_from_hub_register_codes / ADR-0145), not a raw provider code; parcels since merged, split or recoded are carried to the current pnu by the consumer through the place-identity resolver and views.changed_codes (ADR-0288, ADR-0329, ADR-0402)
